{"key":"req-0001","response":{"responseId":"m32Pac_0JuKCqtsP8uKAiQ8","usageMetadata":{"promptTokenCount":5905,"totalTokenCount":18172,"thoughtsTokenCount":11231,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5905}],"candidatesTokenCount":1036},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","candidates":[{"finishReason":"STOP","index":0,"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  // Algorithm: Gradient Glue-Reward Velocity MAB\n\n#ifndef MAX_GLUE_USED\n#define MAX_GLUE_USED 127\n#endif\n\n  // Step 2: Persistent State Variables (EMAs)\n  // [0] = Focused, [1] = Stable\n  static double fast_ema[2] = {0};\n  static double slow_ema[2] = {0};\n  static bool initialized = false;\n\n  // Initialize EMAs on first run\n  if (!initialized) {\n    double init_val = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n    if (init_val == 0)\n      init_val = 10.0; // Reasonable default if stats empty\n    fast_ema[0] = fast_ema[1] = init_val;\n    slow_ema[0] = slow_ema[1] = init_val;\n    initialized = true;\n  }\n\n  // Step 1: Define hybrid cost metric K\n  // Calculate global glue clause ratio R (LBD \u003c= 2) for the current phase.\n  // We use cumulative statistics for the current mode as the phase metric.\n  unsigned mode = solver-\u003estable;\n  uint64_t count_le2 = 0;\n  uint64_t count_total = 0;\n\n  for (int i = 0; i \u003c= MAX_GLUE_USED; i++) {\n    uint64_t val = solver-\u003estatistics.used[mode].glue[i];\n    count_total += val;\n    if (i \u003c= 2)\n      count_le2 += val;\n  }\n\n  double R = (count_total \u003e 0) ? (double) count_le2 / count_total : 0.0;\n  double avg_lbd = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  double K = avg_lbd - (15.0 * R);\n\n  // Step 2 continued: Update the active mode's EMAs with K\n  // fast_ema alpha = 0.05, slow_ema alpha = 0.005\n  fast_ema[mode] += 0.05 * (K - fast_ema[mode]);\n  slow_ema[mode] += 0.005 * (K - slow_ema[mode]);\n\n  // Step 3: Calculate Performance Velocity V\n  // Positive V indicates increasing cost (degrading), negative is improving.\n  double V = fast_ema[mode] - slow_ema[mode];\n\n  // Step 4: Compute Forecasted Cost F\n  double F_current = fast_ema[mode] + (2.5 * V);\n\n  // Calculate F for the candidate (other) mode using its stored state\n  unsigned other = !mode;\n  double V_other = fast_ema[other] - slow_ema[other];\n  double F_other = fast_ema[other] + (2.5 * V_other);\n\n  // Step 5: Select the mode with the lower F\n  // Hysteresis: only switch if F_candidate \u003c 0.9 * F_current\n  if (F_other \u003c 0.9 * F_current) {\n    // Switch mode\n    solver-\u003estable = (bool) other;\n    kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                              \"Gradient MAB switch to %s (F_curr=%.2f, F_cand=%.2f)\",\n                              solver-\u003estable ? \"stable\" : \"focused\",\n                              F_current, F_other);\n    // Return true to trigger restart and effectuate the mode switch\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // Fallback: Standard restart logic for the current mode\n  // If no mode switch is triggered, we check if we should restart within the current mode.\n  if (solver-\u003estable) {\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n  } else {\n    const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n    const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n    const double margin = (100.0 + GET_OPTION (restartmargin)) / 100.0;\n    const double limit = margin * slow;\n    return (limit \u003c= fast);\n  }\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}]}}]},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
